name: Debrify Latest Builds
subtitle: Fresh iOS builds of every nextup commit.
description: Debrify built automatically from every commit to nextup in Alehaaaa/debrify, each with a changelog of what changed since the previous build.

apps.name: Debrify
apps.subtitle: Torrent search and debrid management.
apps.localizedDescription:
A modern torrent search and debrid management app.

These are unsigned commit builds produced by GitHub Actions; SideStore re-signs them with your own certificate on install.
